name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1873: A third static sweep pointed at the same helper the last ship introduced, and the helper was wrong: an unbounded comment stripper removed seventeen percent of the board and 170 of its 444 id declarations, because a slash-star inside a string matches forward to the next star-slash anywhere in the file. The guard it powered had passed on a mangled view, which can only ever be a false negative. Bounding the block form loses none of the 444, the stripper now has its own test run before any verdict built on it is believed, and the new sweep it enabled reports that neither surface looks up an element nothing creates.
